text:
harper (Product): quick Q from the all-hands thread: can we publish a single-line rollout plan for partners that includes owners, brief canary durations, and any SKD/doc freezes? trying to avoid back-and-forth.

diego (Eng): plan proposal: API first (owner: diego) -> Console next (owner: mika) -> Optimize beta overlapping Console stabilization (owner: harper).

mika (DevEx): doc freeze: API docs freeze 48h before GA. SDK bump allowed but no breaking changes. I'll schedule a 30min "what to expect" for partners.

anya (CPO): curious about canary lengths — keep small but measurable. suggested: API 48h (2% -> 10% if healthy), Console 72h with feature flags, Optimize beta rolling 2-week windows.

sam (Infra): infra notes: Dedicated autoscale flag present; need API endpoint to surface pool sizes for Console dashboard (`GET /internal/pools`). canary tooling supports rolling percentages.

security-bot: Security checklist created: /security/checklists/console-ga (telemetry opt-out required for Private).

mika (DevEx): SDK question: are there new required params for Optimize? if not, we're good. If optional, we ship as minor semver and add migration note.

diego (Eng): no required changes. Optimize opts are optional flags. we'll add telemetry default off for Private by default.

harper (Product): ok summary I'll publish: API (owner diego) -> 48h canary -> 7-day observation -> GA. Console (owner mika) -> parity then 72h canary -> GA. Optimize beta (owner harper) -> rolling 2-week cohorts, telemetry opt-out for Private. owners will get calendar invites and links to runbooks.

anya (CPO): thanks, please include the support-runbook link in the partner note and tag security.

mika (DevEx): will do, posting links + invite shortly.
